result.title: MiMaAlign: Hierarchical Micro-Macro Alignment for Physically Plausible Video Generation
result.summary: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models have made remarkable progress in generating high-fidelity visuals, yet their outputs still often exhibit physically implausible phenomena, including discontinuous dynamics and implausible event interactions. Existing representation alignment methods mainly transfer generic video features or short-range motion cues, treating physical plausibility as a single-level representation problem. To address this issue, we propose MiMaAlign, a hierarchical micro-macro alignment framework that transfers complementary dynamics-oriented and event-oriented knowledge into different abstraction depths of a pretrained video diffusion model. Specifically, micro-level continuous dynamics alignment imposes constraints by aligning diffusion features with a continuous-time motion representation learned by a Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (Neural ODE), while macro-level event-commonsense alignment provides representations of object interactions and event semantics through an instruction-prompted vision-language model (VLM). With training-only auxiliary objectives, we align the complementary supervision from the two teachers with shallower and deeper generator features, respectively, enabling the generator to internalize the corresponding physical priors. Empirical evaluations show that, on CogVideoX-2B, MiMaAlign achieves a relative improvement of up to 21.0% in the Physical Commonsense (PC) score on the VideoPhy benchmark over the baseline, and also delivers substantial gains on the highly challenging VideoPhy2 benchmark, while maintaining general video quality on VBench and being supported by blind user comparisons.

AI.brief_summary: 面向 T2V 扩散模型的物理合理性生成，提出 MiMaAlign 分层 micro-macro 对齐框架：用 Neural ODE 学习连续运动表示、用指令提示的 VLM 提供事件常识，并以仅训练期的辅助目标把两类教师监督分别对齐到浅层与深层生成器特征。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按抽象深度分层对齐互补教师表示」的训练监督方式，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节与高层语义在不同层级的保留、以及对内部状态施加辅助监督提供可核查的方法线索，但该文面向视频生成，与 latent 推理状态无直接关系。
